info.title: Veritas command-line, MCP, and SPARQL HTTP server
info.description: A command-line tool, Model Context Protocol server, and SPARQL 1.1 Protocol HTTP endpoint over the Lumoin.Veritas RDF / SPARQL / SHACL engine.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Veritas — RDF / SPARQL / SHACL command-line, MCP server (-mcp), and SPARQL HTTP endpoint.

commands.name: analytics
commands.description: Run a graph-analytics algorithm (degree, triangles, clustering, PageRank, components, cliques) over RDF data files.

options.name: --algo
options.description: Graph-analytics algorithm name (run with --list to see them).

options.name: --data
options.description: RDF data file (.ttl/.nt/.trig/.nq/.rdf/.owl) forming the graph; repeat for several.

options.name: --param
options.description: Algorithm parameter as name=value (for example size=4, connectivity=mutual, damping=0.85); repeat.

options.name: --format
options.description: Result format: csv (default) or tsv.

options.name: --list
options.description: List the available graph-analytics algorithms.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: query
commands.description: Run a SPARQL SELECT/ASK query over RDF data files.

options.name: --data
options.description: RDF data file (.ttl/.nt/.trig/.nq) forming the dataset; repeat for several.

options.name: --format
options.description: Result format: csv (default) or tsv.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

arguments.name: QUERY_FILE
arguments.description: Path to a file containing the SPARQL query.

commands.name: replicate
commands.description: Run a store-backed replica: serve replication on loopback, reconcile with a peer (remove-aware by default), self-heal over the wire, and optionally coordinate identity and lineage on a consensus metadata plane.

options.name: --store
options.description: Store directory the replica opens (created if missing).

options.name: --data
options.description: RDF data file seeding an EMPTY store as the lineage seed; repeat for several.

options.name: --listen
options.description: Loopback TCP port serving replication to peers; 0 picks an ephemeral port, printed as 'listening <port>'.

options.name: --peer
options.description: Peer replication endpoint as host:port; also bindable later with the 'peer' verb.

options.name: --reconcile-interval
options.description: Seconds between automatic reconcile pulls from the peer; absent pulls only on the 'reconcile' verb.

options.name: --self-heal
options.description: Run the background storage self-heal loop, with both peer-repair seams over the bound peer.

options.name: --heal-interval
options.description: Seconds between self-heal rounds (a fixed cadence, no jitter); absent uses the reliability-model cadence.

options.name: --identity-dir
options.description: Directory the HOST's replica identity is persisted in (minted on first use); absent uses the per-user configuration location. Distinct replicas on one machine each need their own directory.

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Perform the explicit causality baseline step on a resumed store that is not already remove-aware; the outcome is reported by name on the identity line.

options.name: --metadata-founder
options.description: Founding member of the consensus metadata chain as <64hex axis>:<32hex store>, which is what the 'axis ... store ...' startup line prints; repeat for every founder. Its presence turns the plane on, and this host's own axis must be among them. Both halves are named because the membership admits the store answering for a replica, so every founder's store must exist and have printed its incarnation before the list can be written.

options.name: --metadata-route
options.description: Metadata endpoint of one founder as <64hex>=<host:port>; repeat for several, or bind later with the 'metadata-route' verb. A founder with no route is treated as an unreachable member.

options.name: --metadata-store
options.description: Directory the consensus host state and this host's confirmed facts are persisted in; absent uses a 'metadata' directory beside the replica identity, never the data store directory a deployment copies per replica.

options.name: --metadata-attempts
options.description: Consensus attempts one coordination obligation may spend before it answers undecided; absent uses the command's own budget.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run a SPARQL 1.1 Protocol HTTP endpoint over RDF data files, optionally hosting the Studio UI (--ui).

options.name: --data
options.description: RDF data file (.ttl/.nt/.trig/.nq) to serve; repeat for several.

options.name: --port
options.description: Loopback port to listen on (default 3030).

options.name: --ui
options.description: Also serve the in-browser Studio UI (from --ui-dir) at the root and open a browser; its tab queries this engine.

options.name: --ui-dir
options.description: Directory of the built Studio web app (its 'dist') to serve with --ui; defaults to a 'ui' directory beside the executable.

options.name: --no-open
options.description: With --ui, do not open a browser automatically.

options.name: --cors-origin
options.description: Origin allowed cross-origin (CORS) access to the endpoints, e.g. a remotely hosted Studio page; repeat for several, or pass * to allow any origin. Absent, no cross-origin access is granted.
